messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 3.3.2

3.3.2. Starting/moving All travel movements of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver shall be possible only if the driver is at the controls. Where, for operating purposes, machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone (e.g. stabilisers, jib, etc.), the driver shall be provided with the means of checking easily, before moving the machinery, that such devices are in a particular position which allows safe movement. This also applies to all other parts which; to allow safe movement, have to be in particular positions, locked if necessary. Where it does not give rise to other risks, movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning of the aforementioned parts. It shall not be possible for unintentional movement of the machinery to occur while the engine is being started. The movement of autonomous mobile machinery shall take into account the risks related to the area where it is intended to move and work.

response.text:
Self-propelled machinery with ride-on driver | travel movements possible only with driver present | driver at the controls | "All travel movements of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver shall be possible only if the driver is at the controls."
Machinery with devices exceeding normal clearance zone | driver provided means of checking device position | before moving the machinery | where for operating purposes machinery is fitted with devices exceeding its normal clearance zone (e.g. stabilisers, jib) | "the driver shall be provided with the means of checking easily, before moving the machinery, that such devices are in a particular position which allows safe movement."
Parts required in particular positions for safe movement | driver provided means of checking position | before moving the machinery | parts that must be in particular positions, locked if necessary | "This also applies to all other parts which; to allow safe movement, have to be in particular positions, locked if necessary."
Movement of machinery | depends on safe positioning of parts | where it does not give rise to other risks | "Where it does not give rise to other risks, movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning of the aforementioned parts."
Unintentional movement of machinery | shall not be possible | while engine is being started | "It shall not be possible for unintentional movement of the machinery to occur while the engine is being started."
Autonomous mobile machinery movement | shall take into account risks of area | area where it is intended to move and work | "The movement of autonomous mobile machinery shall take into account the risks related to the area where it is intended to move and work."
